title: Multisymmetric polynomials on set-theoretic quiver representations
summary: Eventually constant set-valued representations of a quiver are set-theoretic analogues of nilpotent representations. In recent work by Green-Holmes-Im, the authors enumerated eventually constant set-valued representations for equioriented cyclic quivers using the directed matrix-tree theorem. In this paper, we extend this enumeration to finite quivers without sinks for which every vertex is the target of sufficiently long paths.
